reason: The hypothesis transfers the mechanism of W addition from a simple Fe-P-C-B amorphous alloy (P43) to a complex high-entropy CrMnFeCoNiP20 alloy, which is a new material system not studied in the provided passages. The combination of this mechanism with the specific challenges of the high-entropy alloy (limited amorphous retention, complex crystallization) represents a synthesis of findings from two different papers (P43 and P4) into a new proposal.
